# Alife Repository Instructions

The tracked `/AGENTS.md` file is the canonical instruction source for this repository.

Before planning, editing, reviewing, or publishing changes:

1. Read and follow the root `AGENTS.md`.
2. Preserve its architecture, authorization, privacy, caching, bilingual, AI-human-review, testing, and GitHub traceability rules.
3. Follow its Issue, branch, commit, Draft PR, code-review, `/shipit`, and local-development workflows.

Do not duplicate those workflows in this file. When this compatibility file and the root guidance differ, follow `/AGENTS.md`.
